verdicts.rationale: Every divergence hint here is constitution-excluded or non-decision-relevant. The A1/C1 per-seal stamina reduction is stamina (explicitly excluded, Pattern 5). C1's interruption-resist has no schema field and is not a rotation/buff/heal/cooldown fact. The CA damage-mult and AoE-radius scaling with seal count are damage numbers and AoE size (both excluded), with no rendered surface. The seal economy itself is fully modeled — per-swing grants, saturating E/Q grants, CA consume, and swap-off clearing that matches in-game — so nothing on the timeline visibly diverges. The only in-game nuance dropped (10s group-refresh decay) is argued non-decision-relevant (a segment rarely idles 10s mid-combo; swap-off clearing is modeled), and seals are not a rendered surface anyway.
rubricRefs: noCaveat: damage numbers / AoE sizes excluded

The A7 pass already removed a caveat here because it described only working behavior plus kit scaling with no timeline divergence to repair, and the {seal:N} override is a working feature, not a limitation. There is nothing left to caveat.

verdicts.rationale: The C2 CRIT Rate effect is authored with trigger:passive — a permanent conditional stat, not a cast- or hit-anchored window. No buff-window collection bucket matches trigger.type 'passive', so it renders NOTHING: I confirmed empirically that C2 adds zero buff windows over C0 (both show only Proviso). Because the timeline never displays this permanent passive stat, there is no rendered surface to diverge from and no player is misled — consistent with how permanent conditional passive stats are treated tool-wide. The curator note's 'the entry already renders optimistically' is stale, describing the pre-refactor render path (the note predates the 2026-07-17 buff-window derivation). Implement is not clean: the effect is a permanent conditional stat, so re-authoring it as an onHit/charged window would have to invent a duration/cadence (fake timing) to make it render, and its stat cannot be scoped to charged-attacks-only. Note for a reviewer: the invisible-passive-buff situation likely spans the other enemyHp-gated trigger:passive constellations (Razor/Diluc/Eula/Kaeya/Ayato) and is an engine wiring question beyond a single-character caveat.
rubricRefs: noCaveat: no rendered surface to diverge from
presence != reachability (trigger:passive not wired to buff windows)
